name: PRAXIS — Telegram Inbound Control (10i)
description: Praxis_build-10i inbound control channel. Telegram Trigger (message) -> GUARD 1 sender allowlist (from.id AND chat.id == trader 6156528469) -> Build+Write command file /files/tg-inbox/cmd-<update_id>.json (.tmp->rename, atomic appearance) which the host launchd build.praxis.tg-inbound runner claims. Unauthorized senders are dropped (NoOp) and never written to the host inbox. AUTHORITY LOCKED read/report/status only — the host runner enforces the verb allowlist; this workflow only relays the trader's raw text as a command file. active:false — trader imports + activates.

meta.note: 10i inbound control channel — sender-restricted; host runner enforces read/report/status verb allowlist
